title: Medical Appliance Technicians
description: Construct, maintain, or repair medical supportive devices such as braces, orthotics and prosthetic devices, joints, arch supports, and other surgical and medical appliances.

tasks.text: Repair, modify, or maintain medical supportive devices, such as artificial limbs, braces, or surgical supports, according to specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual repair of assistive devices

dwas.name: Repair medical or dental assistive devices.

tasks.text: Polish artificial limbs, braces, or supports, using grinding and buffing wheels.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Polish materials, workpieces, or finished products.
Operate grinding equipment.

tasks.text: Construct or receive casts or impressions of patients' torsos or limbs for use as cutting and fabrication patterns.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Casting molds of patient anatomy is manual lab work

dwas.name: Cast molds of patient anatomies to create medical or dental devices.

tasks.text: Read prescriptions or specifications to determine the type of product or device to be fabricated and the materials and tools required.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse specs and materials from orders

dwas.name: Read work orders or other instructions to determine product specifications or materials requirements.

tasks.text: Make orthotic or prosthetic devices, using materials such as thermoplastic and thermosetting materials, metal alloys and leather, and hand or power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Customized device construction is hands-on fabrication

dwas.name: Construct customized assistive medical or dental devices.

tasks.text: Bend, form, and shape fabric or material to conform to prescribed contours of structural components.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Adjusting fabric is tactile manual work

dwas.name: Adjust fabrics or other materials during garment production.

tasks.text: Test medical supportive devices for proper alignment, movement, or biomechanical stability, using meters and alignment fixtures.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical device inspection requires hands-on access

dwas.name: Inspect medical or dental assistive devices.

tasks.text: Drill and tap holes for rivets, and glue, weld, bolt, or rivet parts together to form prosthetic or orthotic devices.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drilling parts requires physical tool operation

dwas.name: Drill holes in parts, equipment, or materials.
Operate welding equipment.

tasks.text: Lay out and mark dimensions of parts, using templates and precision measuring instruments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drawing guide lines on materials is hands-on

dwas.name: Draw guide lines or markings on materials or workpieces using patterns or other references.

tasks.text: Cover or pad metal or plastic structures or devices, using coverings such as rubber, leather, felt, plastic, or fiberglass.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Customized device construction is hands-on fabrication

dwas.name: Construct customized assistive medical or dental devices.

tasks.text: Order parts or supplies for orthotic or prosthetic devices.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend

dwas.name: Order materials, supplies, or equipment.
Order medical supplies or equipment.

tasks.text: Mix pigments to match patients' skin coloring, according to formulas, and apply mixtures to orthotic or prosthetic devices.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mixing finishes requires hands-on craft judgment

dwas.name: Mix ingredients to create specific finishes.
Apply protective or decorative finishes to workpieces or products.

tasks.text: Service or repair machinery used in the fabrication of appliances.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on repair of production machinery

dwas.name: Repair production equipment or tools.

tasks.text: Take patients' body or limb measurements for use in device construction.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical body measurement for fit

dwas.name: Measure clients to ensure proper product fit.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Instruct patients in use of prosthetic or orthotic devices.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient assistive-equipment instruction is hands-on care

dwas.name: Instruct patients in the use of assistive equipment.

tasks.text: Fit appliances onto patients, and make any necessary adjustments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical body measurement for fit

dwas.name: Measure clients to ensure proper product fit.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information
